connector.name: AIMarket MCP Gateway
connector.registryDescription: Stdio + Streamable-HTTP MCP gateway: SSRF-hardened web_fetch, web_search, metis_verify.
connector.summary: Hosted at {aimarket_host} over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package aimarket-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the alexar76 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token matching AIMARKET_MCP_KEY when auth is enabled
